Georgia Tech offers more than 100 graduate programs across multiple colleges and dozens of schools, including interdisciplinary and certificate options. Students benefit from a top-ranked education, world-class faculty, and a strong focus on research. Through global partnerships and a culture of innovation, Georgia Tech drives groundbreaking discoveries and provides unique international opportunities in research, education, and industry.
